root_cause_criterion.variable: NODE_IS_BACKREF(node) || NODE_IS_CALLED(node) over the BAG_MEMORY nodes reachable from NODE_ANCHOR_BODY(an)
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `tune_look_behind()` rewrites a sure-zero-length look-behind to empty, the selected `BAG_MEMORY` node inside `NODE_ANCHOR_BODY(an)` must not already be back-referenced or called.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the empty-look-behind optimization with `used_capture=1` and still frees the selected capture node. The fixed original is guarded on that same witness, and the adjacent perturbation `literalized_named_backrefs` removes only the two `\k<E>` backreferences, yielding a genuine fixed-side witness with `used_capture=0` while the capture-node free still executes.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The original fixed case emits only guarded root events (`used_capture=1` with no `capture_node_free`). The closest source-grounded perturbation, `literalized_named_backrefs`, flips the last root event to `used_capture=0` and reaches `capture_node_free`, which verifies the missing conjunct as a genuine fixed-side witness.

nodes.state: `onig_node_free()` frees the same selected look-behind capture node during `onig_node_reset_empty()`.
Later backreference-length computation reloads the freed capture pointer from `mem_env[backs[0]].mem_node`.
`node_char_len1()` dereferences the reloaded stale capture pointer at `switch (NODE_TYPE(node))`, matching the AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free read.

edges.relation: The capture node selected from `NODE_ANCHOR_BODY(an)` at the missing-guard site is the exact `Node*` later freed during `onig_node_reset_empty()`.
After `onig_node_reset_empty()` frees the selected capture node, later backreference handling reloads that same pointer from `mem_env[backs[0]].mem_node`.
The stale pointer reloaded from `mem_env[backs[0]].mem_node` becomes the `node` argument dereferenced at `switch (NODE_TYPE(node))`.
